A_pixel_node_states.semantic: Pixel GNN contextual node representations prior to motif composition

B_what_component.semantic: Visual appearance content pooled within spatial anchor windows

C_type_component.semantic: Categorical motif prototype distribution projected to 32 dimensions

E_scale_gating_weights.semantic: Learned softmax weighting over candidate scales (8, 12, 16)

F_pre_projection_input.semantic: Concatenated multi-modal occurrence token prior to occurrence_proj

G_full_pre_motif.semantic: Full projected and scale-composed PRE-Motif occurrence node states
